versions.content: Support of SOVD Description: Diagnostics within AUTOSAR shall support an SOVD endpoint according the ASAM specification "‘SOVD - Service Oriented Vehicle Diagnostics V1.0.0"‘. Rationale: Provide vehicle access for backends AppliesTo: AP Dependencies: ISO14229-1 Use Case: Modernized diagnostic approach in the automotive industry
